svg.text: REGENIE / SAIGE / GENESIS; time-to-event GWAS with local
Key takeaways: typical workflow vs this framework
Nextflow, containerized, parameterized end to end
Fixed R² cut-off for all samples
GRAF-anc (282K SNPs) plus local ancestry inference
External, post hoc if done at all
Built in: WGS truth and simulated GWAS power
One pooled model, PCs as covariates
Per-ancestry GWAS; Tractor separates effects by local ancestry
Cox model blind to ancestry structure
Survival GWAS with local ancestry built in (GENESIS extension)
Ancestry-aware PRS (PRS-CSx, GAUDI), validated per ancestry
Containerized, parallelized, portable; modules run alone or end to end
Every module is an independent Nextflow entry point: run end to end or any module alone. Dashed = optional. Orange = admixed-population method.
